principles.heading: Useful before impressive
principles.body: An idea matters when it works under real conditions — not only when it sounds good.

principles.heading: Care in every medium
principles.body: Whether the work involves software, furniture, instruction, research, or analysis, details deserve attention.

principles.heading: Clarity without oversimplifying
principles.body: Complex ideas can be made understandable without reducing them to something shallow.

principles.heading: Quality over volume
principles.body: We would rather do fewer things well than expand faster than the work can support.

channels.label: AI Consulting
channels.body: Practical AI and technology support for small businesses and individuals — websites, automation, workflows, training, troubleshooting, and classes.

channels.label: Vintage Fashion and Treasures
channels.body: Vintage fashion, distinctive collections, restored and refreshed furniture pieces, unique home accents, and unexpected treasures selected for their character, usefulness, or beauty.

channels.label: Tools for Self-Discovery
channels.body: Thoughtful assessments, guided reflection resources, and personal insight tools — including Raven and The Woven Map — designed to support clearer self-understanding.
